body:
Bring plugins/adlc-codex's P0 ticket-authoring and P7 maintenance skill content up to Claude Code's depth by extending the SATELLITE skills (adlc-spec, adlc-distill), not the phase router.

=== CORRECTED UNDERSTANDING (this ticket originally proposed rewriting the router; that would have been wrong and is now dropped) ===
plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md is a GENERATED file, rendered by scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs from the single canonical scripts/router/router-model.mjs, shared across six harness routers. docs/specs/router-consolidation.md documents an EXPLICIT, TESTED design decision: harnesses fall into two content classes — 'full-map' routers (claude-code, antigravity, opencode, cursor) that include the P0-P7 phase->gate map, and 'minimal' delegating routers (codex, pi) that deliberately do NOT, keeping their body short and pushing depth to satellite skills instead. The spec states outright: 'the generator must not push phase_map onto codex/pi (AC5 guards this: their baseline has ~3 pairs, so an injected full map trips ROUTING DRIFT).' scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs enforces this with a dedicated structural check. This ticket's original AC1 (rewrite the router to carry a full P0-P7 table) would have both fought a deliberate architectural decision and failed an existing test designed specifically to catch that exact change. Dropped entirely -- do not resurrect it.

The REAL, still-valid gap: Codex has no dedicated skill content matching Claude Code's commands/adlc-ticket.md (180 lines: ticket store locking/atomic-write protocol, formatter-exclusion warnings, coldstart integration) or commands/adlc-maintain.md (skill-rot, model-ratchet, ticket-prune, gate-fuzzing walkthrough with exit-code semantics) -- that content is compressed to a handful of lines each inside plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc-spec/SKILL.md and adlc-distill/SKILL.md, which are NOT part of the generated-router system (only the six router paths named in router-model.mjs's `harnesses` map are generated; adlc-spec/adlc-prosecute/adlc-rail-build/adlc-distill/adlc-init are plain hand-authored files, safe to edit directly -- confirmed by grep: none of their paths appear in router-model.mjs).

=== CONTRACT (write then gate) ===
Author .adlc/specs/codex-skill-depth-parity.md before coding (replaces the prior draft, which assumed the router itself needed the P0-P7 table). Must pin: exactly what P0 ticket-authoring content moves into adlc-spec/SKILL.md (locking/atomic-write protocol, formatter-exclusion warning, coldstart integration, adapted from commands/adlc-ticket.md to Codex's `$adlc-*` invocation convention) and what P7 maintenance content moves into adlc-distill/SKILL.md (skill-rot/model-ratchet/ticket-prune/gate-fuzzing walkthrough with exit-code semantics and the cron-vs-session split, adapted from commands/adlc-maintain.md). Before touching ANY file in plugins/adlc-codex/skills/, run `grep -n "<path>" scripts/router/router-model.mjs` to confirm it is NOT a generated target; if it is, edit the model and regenerate instead of hand-editing (T50 made exactly this mistake once already on the router path itself and had to fix it after the drift test caught it).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc-spec/SKILL.md extended with the ticket store locking/atomic-write protocol and formatter-exclusion warning content from commands/adlc-ticket.md, adapted to Codex's `$adlc-*` invocation convention.
2. plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc-distill/SKILL.md extended with the full skill-rot/model-ratchet/ticket-prune/gate-fuzzing walkthrough from commands/adlc-maintain.md, including exit-code semantics and the cron-vs-session split.
3. docs/integrations/codex.md and apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/codex.mdx updated only if this content change materially affects the documented skill list (it should not, since no skill is added/removed/renamed).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: `adlc-spec/SKILL.md` covers the same P0 protocol steps (lock acquisition/release, atomic write, edge validation, coldstart integration, formatter-exclusion check) as `commands/adlc-ticket.md`. VERIFY: a content-presence smoke test asserting required section headers exist in the target file.
- AC2: `adlc-distill/SKILL.md` covers all four P7 checks (skill-rot, model-ratchet, ticket-prune, gate-fuzzing) with their exit-code semantics. VERIFY: same pattern.
- AC3: No skill under `plugins/adlc-codex/skills` references a Claude-Code-only `/adlc:...` invocation form. VERIFY: `grep -r '/adlc:' plugins/adlc-codex/skills` returns zero matches, asserted in the smoke test.
- AC4: `plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md` (the router) is UNCHANGED by this ticket -- still the minimal, no-phase-map form. VERIFY: `git diff --stat main -- plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md` is empty on this ticket's branch; `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs --check` still passes.
- AC5: `adlc rails-guard --base main --ticket T51` passes; `npm test` passes; existing skill packaging/smoke tests (`scripts/codex-install-smoke.mjs`) still pass.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Any change to `scripts/router/router-model.mjs`, `plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md`, or any other generated router file.
- Any hook/agent code changes (T48-T50 own those) -- this ticket is documentation-only.
- Renaming or removing any existing skill.
- T48/T49/T50/T52/T53.
title: Enrich Codex's satellite skills (P0 ticket authoring + P7 maintenance) — NOT the router
